children: Coda Octopus Group, Inc. (NASDAQ:CODA) reported Q3 strength with revenue up 9.2% QoQ, buoyed by a 131% jump in marine rental and a 68.3% rise in Defense Services, DAVD Untethered approvals and deliveries, solid margins and cash, but regional geopolitical turmoil is pressuring product orders.
: Coda Octopus (CODA) saw consolidated revenue up 9.2% QoQ. Marine rental revenue jumped 131% QoQ; equipment sales fell 17.8%. PAL sales rose 10.4% QoQ. Defense Services revenue increased 68.3% QoQ.
: Coda Octopus (CODA): U.S. Navy approved DAVD Untethered; 24 DAVD systems delivered; European Navy interest. Nano 3D sonar nearing sea trials. $31.7M cash, no debt, positive retained earnings.
: Coda Octopus Group (CODA) Q3 2026: gross profit $5.1M (65.4% margin), operating income $1.5M (19.9% margin), pre-tax ~$1.8M, net ~$1.4M, diluted EPS $0.12

: Coda Octopus (CODA) reports rising U.S. Defense Engineering Services backlog, a multi-year repair and sustainment contract from a U.S. government prime, and stronger spare‑parts demand year‑to‑date.
: Coda Octopus (CODA) says Middle East geopolitical turmoil has cut demand in Asia and the Middle East; management expects ongoing regional uncertainty to keep pressuring product orders.
: Coda Octopus Group (CODA) will hold a conference call on Sept. 14, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. ET to discuss results; dial-in and replay details were provided in the press release.
